resources.string: What each tool may reach, when it last ran, and what its downloads take

Android gives a permission to the whole app, not to one tool, so taking one back stops every tool listed beside it. A permission that was never given asks again the next time a tool needs it. Use is counted by the keyboard each time a tool opens; it is saved when the keyboard closes.
Its options, and its switch on the toolbar
Allowed, a tap opens Android\'s page for this app, where the permission can be taken back. Not allowed, a tap opens the Permissions screen, which asks for it.
